prompts:
Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. original design, not resembling any Nintendo / Game Freak / Pokémon asset.
Create ONE production tile atlas, exactly 8 columns x 4 rows, each cell 16x16 logical pixels; whole sheet 128x64 logical pixels enlarged uniformly 8x to 1024x512. No gutters, margins, grid lines, labels or text. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. References are style only. First reference outdoor tiles dictates ground colors: slate grey road, cream sidewalks, soft green grass, teal canal. Ground cells must be opaque full squares, continuing exactly to all four edges; transparent background only behind traffic light and tree quadrants. Each art pixel is a uniform 8x8 square.
ROW 1: road corner NE, road corner NW, road corner SE, road corner SW, T junction N, T junction S, T junction E, T junction W.
Road turns and junctions use slate asphalt with cream curb corners, thin dark tan curb divisions. NE corner means road exits top and right; NW top and left; SE bottom and right; SW bottom and left. T N means exits north east west (and analogously S E W). Road openings are 10 logical pixels wide centered, all edge connection positions identical.
ROW 2: four way intersection; vertical road dashed cream lane marking; freestanding traffic signal on transparent (three tiny red amber green lights on dark pole); zebra crossing corner on asphalt; full red brick paving; full park gravel path; sakura tree top left quadrant; sakura tree top right quadrant.
ROW 3: sakura tree bottom left quadrant; sakura tree bottom right quadrant; autumn tree top left quadrant; autumn tree top right quadrant; autumn tree bottom left quadrant; autumn tree bottom right quadrant; hedge corner on grass; blue and white flower bed on grass.
Each tree comprises exactly four 16px cells assembled to one 32x32 tree. Sakura has rounded pink cream foliage and brown trunk, autumn orange gold vermilion foliage. Position quadrant crops so assembled trees connect perfectly despite their separated sheet positions. Transparent outside tree silhouette.
ROW 4: canal north bank (stone edge at top, water below); canal south bank (water above stone edge at bottom); seamless full canal teal water; stepping stones on green grass; lily pads on teal water; small flower patch on grass; small stone on grass; drain grate embedded in full cream sidewalk.
Use sparse large pixel clusters, no fine noise, antialiasing, shadows or outlines around individual tile cells. Seamless grass and water share exact base colors with reference. All ground cells fully opaque.
